evidence: The owner, 2026-09-02, finding an E3M1 review map mirrored against the editor. Said to the agent in conversation on 2026-09-02; his words are not quoted in the repository. tests/test_plan_orientation.py holds the rule ('The owner reads this map in XMapEdit').
bloodmap/sector_map.py:168 and bloodmap/analysis.py:336 draw +Y down (read 2026-11-26); a note that the library's renders are Y-flipped is out of date
use: Draw with the library's renderers, which follow the editor; never flip.
